settings.hero_body: Your request for just one has been considered. There are eight very persuasive faces here, and this complete set means you can stop negotiating with your favorites.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_title: Motion carried. Bring the crew home.
settings.final_body: The complete set includes all eight members of this very small council.
settings.moods_body: The vote is unanimous: every pictured companion comes with the set.

settings.personality_body: Keep the full council together or assign a few to desk duty. Eight separate plushes give the joke a place in your actual room.
